watchdog_record_producer_schema_gap.finding: The current runner validate_watchdog_record() reads total_seconds and unconditionally includes it in numeric, finite, bounded, and elapsed-delta checks. Five actual watchdog producers do not emit total_seconds, so every record in these five phases will be rejected despite valid start/body/cleanup/finish observations. The contract is sound because it requires exact monotonic/body/cleanup/total budgets; the reader must derive total from finished-start or accept an exact producer-specific schema while preserving that total predicate.
